digest.component_or_area: outbound parent write paths — CREATE emit and ACLI attach fallback
propositions: CREATE emit with a bound non-epic parent drops the parent without recording a durable bridge alert, only logging debug
ACLI attach fallback swallows HTTP 400 rejection of a non-epic parent without calling record_parent_divergence, leaving no operator-visible record
The two surfaces lack the durable alerting mechanism that UPDATE emit (9f26) and UPDATE apply (dispatch_one) already enforce per the project's own pass_io and dispatch_one contract
An unbound parent must stay silent on both surfaces because it converges on a later pass; alerting on it would be churn
The epic-only parent guard is unconditional but its justification differs between Cloud (400 rejects non-epic) and Data Center (accepts and ignores), which the docs and comments currently conflate
